name: prevalence/support
reviewer_question: Is the lift, or the patient pattern, just held-out malignant prevalence and malignant-cell support rather than biology?
standard_tests: Prevalence/support-matched lift by malignant-cell subsampling; normalized lift (AP-pi)/(1-pi) beside raw lift; AUROC companion; within-representation rank correlation of lift with prevalence

name: held-out patient in the basis
reviewer_question: Stage 1 saw the held-out patient's cells (transductive basis). Does transfer survive when the basis is fit without that patient?
standard_tests: Inductive LOPO Stage 1 (fit without the held-out patient, standardize on training cells, project); compare per-patient lift with the transductive anchor; principal angles and matched factor correlation to the transductive basis

name: winner's curse in selection
reviewer_question: Is 'best DR' (method, K, C) chosen in-sample on the same held-out folds it is scored on?
standard_tests: Nested or prespecified selection (inner LOPO picks method, K and C; outer fold scores); report pooled AP, median lift and P20 lift together; compare nested with in-sample winners

name: fixed-C L1 artifact
reviewer_question: Is the pattern (all-zero folds, missing patients, flat curves) produced by L1 at one fixed C rather than by the representation?
standard_tests: L1 entry-threshold audit (training class-mean gap vs about 4/(C*n_train)); per-fold inner-LOPO C; L2 and elastic-net side by side; C sweep around the stored value

name: donor vs recipient origin or genotype
reviewer_question: Every malignant cell is recipient-derived and almost every normal cell is donor-derived. Is the probe separating donor from recipient (HLA, sex chromosomes, genotype) instead of malignant from normal?
standard_tests: Score recipient-healthy cells with stored models; HLA, ERAP2, chrY and XIST loading checks; donor/recipient sex-match table; donor-downsampling with condition-specific C; ablate sex-chromosome and HLA genes

name: malignant-label assay differs by patient
reviewer_question: The malignant label comes from different evidence per patient (Souporcell, Numbat, mtDNA, immunophenotype, cluster). Does a patient-specific axis track the label pipeline rather than biology?
standard_tests: Per-patient label-provenance column on patient-level views; stratify or harmonize by label source; pre-registered label harmonization for new patients

name: patient nested in batch
reviewer_question: Patients are nested in sequencing batches. Is a patient-specific or shared axis a batch effect?
standard_tests: Batch-membership table against patient axes; within-batch comparisons where several patients share a batch; batch covariate checks on factor scores

name: cell-type composition
reviewer_question: Is the factor or the lift driven by different predicted cell-type composition of malignant and normal cells, or of patients?
standard_tests: Factor x predicted cell type association stratified by label and patient; within-cell-type lift; composition-matched comparisons; factor x CLR/dsb-normalized ADT

name: n=7 patients
reviewer_question: With seven supported patients, is any cohort-level statement more than a description of these patients?
standard_tests: Patient-cluster bootstrap CIs; exact patient-level sign and permutation tests; external validation on new patients

name: sign/rotation non-identifiability
reviewer_question: Factor signs, orders and rotations are arbitrary. Is a named factor the same object across methods, K, folds and patients?
standard_tests: Name factors from both poles with sign(beta) orientation; many-to-one matching across method and K (R2, principal angles, Tucker phi); pattern vs structure loadings for oblique rotations; target rotation

name: single Stage 1 seed
reviewer_question: Every Stage 1 basis was fit once with one seed. Does the factor recur across seeds and resamples?
standard_tests: Seeds x patient-stratified bootstrap with component clustering; recurrence and sign consistency per factor; factor determinacy

name: any N genes would do
reviewer_question: Would a random gene set of the same size and expression profile give the same lift?
standard_tests: Null Model 1: matched random gene sets (size and expression/detection bins, plus a co-expression-matched variant) through the same scoring; empirical p per panel with BH adjustment

name: degenerate or blown-up factors
reviewer_question: Are weights or calls driven by numerically degenerate or blown-up late factors (for example in factosig_promax fits)?
standard_tests: Degenerate-factor flag; effective_k; exclude or down-weight blown-up factors in variance weights; check FA determinacy
